rows.notes: 3.6m x 25x50mm Green Treated Type A Batten, £5.14 inc VAT each. Lawsons stocks 25x50 not 50x22 so the section is 3mm thicker than B&Q's batten_h=22mm; verify against OpenSCAD batten_h before cutting if shelf_thickness is sensitive. Each 3.6m stick yields 8x426mm cuts (3408mm + kerf, fits in 3600); 2 sticks cover all 11 cuts with 5 spare. Click & collect from Acton W3 8BL.

125x1800mm Green Featheredge, £2.45 inc VAT each. Lawsons doesn't stock 125-wide in 2.4m so layout uses 1800mm boards: 22 boards via packing 8x(822+429+429) + 9x(822+750) + 4x(750+750) + 1x(750+429) = 17/18/17 cuts exactly. EX 22mm thick edge tapering down (standard featheredge profile). Click & collect from Acton W3 8BL.
AFIT Galvanised Gate Tee Hinges 400mm (16 inch) heavy duty, 2-pack. One pack gives 2 hinges for the door.

Cuprinol Garden Shades Country Cream Matt Exterior Wood paint, 2.5L. Off-white cream shade. NO separate primer/undercoat needed — Garden Shades is formulated to soak directly into bare softwood and pressure-treated timber; 2 coats recommended. 2.5L covers ~12 m² per coat; total external surface area of the bin store is ~6 m², so one tin easily covers 2 coats. Let pressure-treated timber dry ~2-4 weeks before painting.
SkyGuard EPDM Rubber Roof Kit 1.4m x 2.4m, £77.66. Generous overhang for a 1300x750 bin-store roof; kit includes adhesive.

Hardwood Plywood 2440x1220x18mm B/BB Face Class 2, £47.05 inc VAT. EN636-2 / Class 2 = exterior bonded — marine BS1088 is over-spec for a roof deck under EPDM. Sole 18mm cut is the 1350x800 roof deck; one sheet covers it with plenty of waste. Click & collect from Acton W3 8BL.

Hardwood Plywood 2440x1220x5.5mm B/BB Face Class 2, £21.61 inc VAT each. Nominal 6mm panels are typically actual 5.5mm — functionally equivalent for the back panel. Two 1300x824mm pieces don't nest on a single sheet (1300+1300 > 2440 and 824+824 > 1220) so 2 sheets needed. Class 2 / EN636-2 = exterior bonded. Click & collect from Acton W3 8BL.

2.4m x 47x75mm C24 Treated Carcassing Timber, £6.78 inc VAT each. Section is 47x75 vs the original 34x70 target — 13mm thicker and 5mm wider, so the door will look slightly chunkier. Trade-off is favourable: regularised C24 pressure-treated softwood is genuinely more weather-resistant than untreated planed whitewood for an exterior bin-store door. Each 2.4m stick fits one 1540mm + one 682mm cut (~2225mm + kerf). Click & collect from Acton W3 8BL.
